verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's docs direct users to explore the Public API through a vendor-hosted Swagger UI at bitwarden.com/help/api/, built on an OAS3 swagger.json, plus a parallel Swagger UI for the `bw serve` Vault Management API. The evidence describes this as a runnable in-browser console, so an interactive reference exists for both APIs. The probe 404s on root openapi paths do not contradict this, since the definition is served under /help/api/. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that try-it-out requests actually execute, and evidence of language-specific runnable code samples beyond the Swagger console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Explore the OpenAPI Specification using the Swagger UI:
the runnable console renders in-browser rather than in the served HTML
The Public API is compatible with the OpenAPI Specification (OAS3) and publishes a compliant [`swagger.json`](/help/api/) definition file.
